sentences.en: To our great annoyance, he barged in on our party.
sentences.zh: 令我们非常恼火的是，他闯进了我们的聚会。

sentences.en: This is my room. You can't just barge in here!
sentences.zh: 这是我的房间。你不能就这样闯进来！

sentences.en: You can't just barge in here whenever you feel like it.
sentences.zh: 你不能想来就来，想走就走地闯进来。

senses.zh: 用船运输；蛮不讲理地闯入或打扰某事物
